statement: Between 2026-09-26 and 2026-11-02, the United States government and the government of Iran each publicly confirm acceptance of an agreement under which the Strait of Hormuz is reopened to commercial shipping.
resolution: TRUE if, between 2026-09-26 and 2026-11-02, both the White House or State Department and the Iranian Foreign Ministry publicly confirm an agreement providing for reopening the Strait of Hormuz, as reported by Reuters and AP.
failure_condition: MISS if, by 2026-11-05, no agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz was publicly confirmed by both the US government and the Iranian government within the window.

statement: Between 2026-09-26 and 2026-11-13, the Kremlin and the Office of the President of Ukraine each publicly state that Russia and Ukraine have agreed to a mutual halt on strikes against energy infrastructure.
resolution: TRUE if, between 2026-09-26 and 2026-11-13, both the Kremlin and the Ukrainian presidential office publicly confirm a bilateral agreement to stop strikes on energy infrastructure, as reported by Reuters and AP; unilateral or US-only announcements do not count.
failure_condition: MISS if, by 2026-11-17, the Kremlin and the Ukrainian presidential office had not both confirmed a mutual energy-infrastructure strike moratorium agreed within the window.

statement: Between 2026-09-26 and 2026-11-13, the Ethiopian federal government declares a state of emergency covering all or part of the Tigray, Amhara, or Afar regions.
resolution: TRUE if, between 2026-09-26 and 2026-11-13, the Ethiopian Council of Ministers or federal parliament issues a state of emergency declaration covering any part of Tigray, Amhara, or Afar, reported by Reuters and AP.
failure_condition: MISS if, by 2026-11-17, no Ethiopian federal state of emergency declaration covering any part of Tigray, Amhara, or Afar was issued within the window.

statement: The FOMC statement released on 2026-10-28 raises the federal funds target range above 3.75 to 4.00 percent. Reference: target range 3.75 to 4.00 percent on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if the FOMC statement dated 2026-10-28 on federalreserve.gov sets a federal funds target range whose upper bound exceeds 4.00 percent; a hold or a cut resolves FALSE. Reference: 3.75 to 4.00 percent on the packet date.
failure_condition: MISS if the 2026-10-28 FOMC statement leaves the target range at 3.75 to 4.00 percent or lowers it.

statement: The ICE Brent crude front-month futures settlement price on 2026-10-30 is below 90.00 USD per barrel. Reference: 99.46 USD on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if the official ICE Futures Europe settlement price for the front-month Brent crude contract on 2026-10-30 is below 90.00 USD per barrel. Reference: 99.46 USD on the packet date.
failure_condition: MISS if the front-month Brent settlement on 2026-10-30 is at or above 90.00 USD per barrel.

statement: Between 2026-09-26 and 2026-10-23, CISA adds CVE-2026-48842 (Roundcube Webmail virtuser_query pre-authentication SQL injection) to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog JSON feed lists CVE-2026-48842 with a dateAdded value between 2026-09-26 and 2026-10-23 inclusive.
failure_condition: MISS if CVE-2026-48842 is absent from the KEV catalog at the deadline or carries a dateAdded value outside the window.

statement: Between 2026-09-26 and 2026-10-09, Pakistani authorities suspend mobile internet service in Islamabad in connection with the PTI march on the capital.
resolution: TRUE if NetBlocks or the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority publicly confirms a suspension of mobile internet or mobile data service in Islamabad on any day between 2026-09-26 and 2026-10-09 inclusive.
failure_condition: MISS if no suspension of mobile internet service in Islamabad occurred on any day within the window.

statement: Democratic candidates win at least 218 seats in the US House of Representatives in the 2026-11-03 general election, as called by the Associated Press.
resolution: TRUE if, by 2026-12-04, the Associated Press has called at least 218 US House races from the 2026-11-03 general election for Democratic candidates.
failure_condition: MISS if, by 2026-12-04, the Associated Press has called fewer than 218 House seats for Democratic candidates.

statement: Between 2026-09-26 and 2027-03-19, a royal proclamation dissolving the UK Parliament and calling a general election is published in the London Gazette.
resolution: TRUE if the London Gazette publishes a proclamation dissolving Parliament for a UK general election with a publication date between 2026-09-26 and 2027-03-19 inclusive.
failure_condition: MISS if no proclamation dissolving Parliament for a UK general election was published in the London Gazette within the window.

statement: Between 2026-09-26 and 2026-11-06, the President issues a Major Disaster Declaration for the State of Hawaii for Hurricane Nolo, as listed in the FEMA disaster declarations database.
resolution: TRUE if the FEMA declarations database on fema.gov lists a Major Disaster Declaration (DR number) for Hawaii whose incident description names Nolo or its late-September 2026 rainfall, declared between 2026-09-26 and 2026-11-06.
failure_condition: MISS if, at the deadline, no Major Disaster Declaration for Hawaii attributable to Nolo appears in the FEMA declarations database with a declaration date inside the window.
